name: field
title: Field
description: A component that provides labelling and validation for form controls.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { box } from 'svelte-toolbelt';
  import { useControl } from '$lib/components/ui/form/form-field-state.svelte.js';
  import { useId } from '$lib/components/ui/form/internal/id';
  import type { ControlProps } from './types.js';

  let { id = useId(), children }: ControlProps = $props();

  const controlState = useControl({
    id: box.with(() => id)
  });
</script>

{@render children?.({ props: controlState.props })}

{#if child} {@render child({ props: mergedProps })} {:else}
{@render children?.()}
{/if}

<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { FormPathLeaves as _FormPathLeaves } from 'sveltekit-superforms';

  type T = unknown;
  type U = unknown;
</script>

<script lang="ts" generics="T extends Record<string, unknown>, U extends _FormPathLeaves<T>">
  import { box } from 'svelte-toolbelt';
  import { useElementField } from '$lib/components/ui/form/form-field-state.svelte.js';
  import type { ElementFieldProps } from './types.js';

  let { form, name, children }: ElementFieldProps<T, U> = $props();

  const elementFieldState = useElementField({
    form: box.with(() => form),
    name: box.with(() => name)
  });
</script>

{@render children?.(elementFieldState.snippetProps)}

{#if childrenProp} {@render childrenProp({ errorProps: fieldErrorsState.errorProps, errors: fieldErrorsState.field.errors })} {:else} {#each fieldErrorsState.field.errors as error, i (i + error)}
{error}
{/each} {/if}
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
  import type { LabelRootProps } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import { box, mergeProps } from 'svelte-toolbelt';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';
  import {
    getField,
    getFormControl2,
    useLabel
  } from '$lib/components/ui/form/form-field-state.svelte.js';
  import { useId } from '$lib/components/ui/form/internal/id';

  let {
    id = useId(),
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: LabelRootProps & HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> = $props();

  const formField = getField();
  const control = getFormControl2();
  if (!formField && !control) {
    throw new Error('Label must be used within a Field or Control component');
  }

  const labelState = useLabel({
    id: box.with(() => id),
    ref: box.with(
      () => ref,
      (v) => (ref = v)
    )
  });

  const mergedProps = $derived(
    mergeProps(
      {
        'data-slot': 'field-label',
        class: cn(
          'inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-base/4.5 text-foreground sm:text-sm/4',
          className
        ),
        ...restProps
      },
      labelState.props
    )
  );
</script>

<label {...mergedProps}>
  {@render children?.()}
</label>
{@render childrenProp?.(fieldState.snippetProps)}
